# Silas — The Journal

Settled studies, daily reads, and the dig — the journal of Dexter Carter, written with Silas, his biblical study desk and ghostwriter. Published openly: named, provenanced, and correctable.

Author and publisher: Dexter Carter. Written with Silas, his biblical study desk and ghostwriter. Scripture: ESV.
License note: read, share, and reuse with attribution to Dexter Carter (asksilas.org); canonical URL per entry.
